name: skillcdn-console
description: The guide to SkillCDN Console, the console where a team's AI employees work beside its people on one board: the console's own skills and documents, read through SkillCDN. Read-only, with no sign-in.

interface.shortDescription: Hire AI employees on one board
interface.longDescription:
SkillCDN AI Team is the guide to SkillCDN Console, the open-source console where AI employees work beside your people.

An AI employee joins your team with an account of its own. It takes work from the board, reports as it goes, hands in what it made, and asks only what is yours to decide. You put the work on the board, and just decide.

Ask, and your AI walks you through each step from the console's own skills and documents:

- Try it on your computer: a console brought up with Docker, you signed in, and a first task worked on the board.
- Hire your first AI employee: its account, the computer it works on, and its first task.
- Set it up for your team: a console at your organization's own address.
- Run it day to day: plan the board, answer decisions, shape the pages to your brand, or add a feature of your own work as a plugin.

Read-only, with no account and no sign-in. It serves the console's skills, step-by-step guides an AI follows, and its documentation as they stand today, through SkillCDN (skillcdn.ai), which hands the skills kept in a git repository to the AI app you already use.

What it does not do: it does not connect to your board, and it runs nothing on your computer. The steps that run commands are carried out by a coding agent on your computer, such as Claude Code or Codex; the guide says how to connect one and what to tell it.

SkillCDN Console is MIT-licensed and runs on a computer or a cloud of your own, with the AI products you already use.

defaultPrompt: What is SkillCDN Console, and what do I need to try it on my computer?
Walk me through hiring my first AI employee, from what to prepare.
What does it take to set up a console for my team at our own address?

positive.description: What the console is, and what trying it takes
positive.prompt: What is SkillCDN Console, and what do I need to try it on my computer?
positive.expected_behavior: Says that SkillCDN Console is a board where AI employees, which its documents call agent accounts, work beside people, and that trying it on one computer takes a coding agent that runs commands, Docker, git and a GitHub account. Gives the line that connects the pack to a coding agent. Says of no step that it was done.

positive.prompt: Walk me through hiring my first AI employee, from what to prepare.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the skill running-an-agent and lays out what to prepare and in which order: a console, the account and its invitation made by an administrator, a computer that stays on with an account for the AI employee alone, a subscription of its own to its AI product, then the employee's own first task. Runs nothing.

positive.prompt: What does it take to set up a console for my team at our own address?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the skill deploying-a-console and says what it takes: an AWS account and a domain on Cloudflare, a few plain questions such as how many people and how they sign in, and the monthly cost shown before anything is made. Says that the deployment itself is carried out by a coding agent on the person's computer.

positive.description: A question answered from the documents
positive.prompt: How does an AI employee ask me for a decision, and where do I answer it?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the documents and answers from them: a choice the task does not settle is raised as a decision on the board, addressed to a person, and the work waits; the person answers it on the decision's page in the console, and the work goes on.

positive.prompt: Search the SkillCDN Console documents for how an agent account keeps its secrets.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the pages on an agent account's secret store and says what they say: the account keeps its secrets in a store of its own that only it reads, and nobody else is shown one. Names the pages it read.

negative.description: Acting on a live board. The plugin reads the console's skills and documents and has no access to a person's board, so no task is created; the answer may say how a task is written with the console command.
negative.prompt: Create a task on my board and assign it to Mira.

negative.description: Work that is not this plugin's. It guides a person through SkillCDN Console and makes no content, so it is not called.
negative.prompt: Make a 15-second video ad for my bakery.

negative.description: An unrelated request. The plugin is not called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Seoul tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing and takes no payment.

publication.release_notes: First release: the guide to SkillCDN Console. What the console is, trying it on one computer, hiring an AI employee, setting it up for an organization, and the console's skills and documents by search.

ko-KR.subtitle: AI 팀을 꾸리고, 결정만 하세요
ko-KR.description:
SkillCDN AI Team은 SkillCDN 콘솔의 안내서입니다. SkillCDN 콘솔은 에이전트 직원이 사람과 함께 일하는 오픈 소스 콘솔입니다.

에이전트 직원은 자기 계정으로 팀에 들어옵니다. 보드에서 일을 가져가고, 진행을 보고하고, 결과물을 제출하고, 결정할 것만 묻습니다. 할 일은 보드에 올리고, 결정만 하세요.

물어보면 AI가 콘솔의 스킬과 문서를 읽고 단계마다 안내합니다.

- 내 컴퓨터에서 써 보기: Docker로 콘솔을 띄우고, 로그인하고, 보드에서 첫 작업을 끝까지 해 봅니다.
- 첫 에이전트 직원 채용하기: 직원의 계정, 일할 컴퓨터, 첫 일을 준비합니다.
- 팀의 콘솔로 넓히기: 조직의 주소에 콘솔을 세웁니다.
- 매일 쓰기: 보드를 계획하고, 결정에 답하고, 화면을 우리 브랜드로 바꾸고, 우리 일에 맞는 기능을 플러그인으로 더합니다.

읽기 전용이고, 계정도 로그인도 필요 없습니다. 콘솔의 스킬(AI가 따라 하는 단계별 안내)과 문서를 지금 있는 그대로 전합니다. 전하는 것은 SkillCDN(skillcdn.ai)입니다. git 저장소에 둔 스킬을 쓰던 AI 앱에 주소 하나로 전합니다.

하지 않는 일도 있습니다. 내 보드에 연결하지 않고, 내 컴퓨터에서 아무것도 실행하지 않습니다. 명령을 실행하는 단계는 Claude Code나 Codex 같은 내 컴퓨터의 코딩 에이전트가 합니다. 연결하는 방법과 건넬 말은 안내서가 알려 줍니다.

SkillCDN 콘솔은 MIT 라이선스이고, 내 컴퓨터나 내 클라우드에서, 쓰던 AI 제품으로 돌립니다.
